default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-628.title: Joint index-and-dollar move fade
E-628.hypothesis: The index and the dollar normally move in opposite directions; when both rise (or fall) strongly together the index move lacks its usual macro backing and the unusual co-move tends to unwind.

E-629.title: Return-skewness extreme fade
E-629.hypothesis: Strong skew of recent 1-bar returns means a few jump bars dominated a window; the jump is liquidity driven and partly reverts.

E-630.title: Kaufman adaptive average cross follow
E-630.hypothesis: KAMA slows down in noise and speeds up in efficient moves, so a close crossing it by a margin marks a trend the noise filter accepts; follow it.

E-631.title: Donchian midline cross follow
E-631.hypothesis: The midpoint of the N-minute high-low channel is the balance level; a close crossing it shifts the side holding the recent range and trend followers join.

E-632.title: Fisher transform extreme hook
E-632.hypothesis: The Fisher transform stretches the tails of the price position in its range; a turn out of a strong extreme shows exhaustion of a push, so trade the hook.

E-633.title: Elder-ray pullback in a rising EMA
E-633.hypothesis: In a trending EMA, bear (bull) power dipping deeply and turning marks the end of a pullback by counter-trend traders; resume the trend.

E-634.title: Vortex indicator gap cross follow
E-634.hypothesis: Vortex compares upward and downward travel against true range; a clear gap between the two shows one side owning the movement, and followers extend it.

E-635.title: Ichimoku tenkan-kijun cross follow
E-635.hypothesis: Midpoints of two high-low windows are robust to closes; the short one crossing the long one shows the recent range shifting direction.

E-636.title: Awesome oscillator saucer
E-636.hypothesis: Inside a positive (negative) AO regime, two weakening bars followed by a strengthening one show momentum pausing and resuming; trade the resumption.

E-637.title: Volatility-ratio jump follow
E-637.hypothesis: When short-term volatility jumps relative to the last hour, new information is arriving; the direction of the short move is followed before it is fully priced.
